thread:
maria_cs: Quick sync — EverSea Payments (trial) is spiking in EU and is at risk for churn if we don't smooth their onboarding. They asked for a temporary QPS increase to handle demo traffic, plus an EU-only allowlist and region pin. Can eng/ops help with a temporary config that auto-reverts?

ash_eng: Thanks — can you paste the customer IP ranges and the exact QPS target + duration? We should do auto_revoke and set monitoring alerts.

maria_cs: IPs: 34.210.44.0/24, 3.122.11.0/24. Target QPS: 500 sustained for next 48h, start ASAP. Prefer region: eu-west-1 only. Auto-revoke after 48h and notify CS channel when revoked. Renewal is in 6 weeks, so want to avoid a bad experience.

noah_ops: Noted. I'll run a quick capacity check for eu-west-1 before applying. If we can't hit 500 sustained on their tenant alone, we can do soft burst + consistent baseline 200. Also recommend a canary route for a subset of tokens for 30m to validate.

ash_eng: Capacity check passed for 48h window (nodes available). I can apply a temporary bucketed policy: baseline 200 QPS + burst to 500, with prefix caching enabled. Will also add IP allowlist to their proxy ACL and pin requests to eu-west-1. Sample config I'm about to push:

```
{
  "customer": "eversea-payments",
  "policy": "temp_qps",
  "baseline_qps": 200,
  "burst_qps": 500,
  "regions": ["eu-west-1"],
  "allowlist": ["34.210.44.0/24", "3.122.11.0/24"],
  "auto_revoke_hours": 48,
  "notify_channel": "#customer-success"
}
```

ash_eng: I'll schedule the change now; will post the deploy output here.

deploy-bot: deploy-started eversea-temp-qps-6123456789 by ash_eng

ash_eng: Ran the command: `rctl apply --customer eversea-payments --file /tmp/eversea-temp-qps.json`

deploy-bot: config-applied eversea-payments: temp_qps policy active. Expires 2026-03-30T14:03:00Z. Allocated nodes in eu-west-1: 3. ACLs updated.

sam_se: Can CS add a renewal note and tag this as "high-touch trial" in the CRM? Also schedule a 30-min enablement tomorrow to walk them through best practices (caching, batching). I'll join.

maria_cs: Yes — creating renewal ticket and scheduling enablement (tomorrow 10:00 CET). I'll also send the short feedback/usage form after the enablement. Link: https://forms.redwood/eversea-onboard (sent to customer).

noah_ops: I'll attach live traces to the alert dashboard and watch for latency spikes. If we see >5% p99 increase, I'll drop burst to 300 and notify.

ash_eng: Logged the config and the rollback plan. Auto-revoke set. Leaving monitoring hooks and an incident playbook reference in the ticket.

maria_cs: Thanks team. I'll follow up in 24h with the customer health update. :thumbsup:
